about.intro_content: Prof. Lanjun Zhang is Professor and Chief of the Department of Thoracic Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), a department recognised as a National Key Clinical Specialty by China's Ministry of Health since 2011. He specialises in lung and esophageal cancer surgery.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Zhang trained in cardio-thoracic surgery at the Fourth Military Medical University before completing his PhD in Clinical Oncology at Sun Yat-sen University, where his doctoral research on artificial bio-material esophagus reconstruction led to a patented artificial esophagus technique in 2001. He has published over 35 papers in the last decade in journals including the Journal of Clinical Oncology, European Journal of Cardio-Thoracic Surgery and Annals of Oncology, covering lung cancer, esophageal cancer, tumour biomarkers and prognostic stratification. He has led the Thoracic Surgery Department since 2010.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Lanjun Zhang

items.question: Does Prof. Lanjun Zhang accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to lung or esophageal cancer surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Zhang's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Zhang specialises in thoracic surgical oncology, including lung and esophageal cancer surgery, and is known for pioneering reconstructive techniques using artificial bio-materials.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Zhang perform reconstructive surgery after tumour resection?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zhang developed a patented artificial esophagus technique and has published research on chest wall reconstruction using biomaterial ribs and pleura following extensive tumour resection.

items.question: What department does Prof. Zhang lead at SYSUCC?
items.answer: Prof. Zhang is Chief of the Department of Thoracic Surgery at SYSUCC, which has been designated a National Key Clinical Specialty by China's Ministry of Health since 2011.
